name: Discord
tagline: API for bots, OAuth2 apps, and Discord platform integrations
description: Discord provides a REST and Gateway API for building bots and applications that interact with servers, channels, messages, users, and voice. Developers create applications in the Discord Developer Portal, authenticate with bot tokens or OAuth2, and call versioned HTTP endpoints under discord.com/api. Official docs cover rate limits, intents, and gateway websockets.

auth.details: Bot token via Authorization: Bot YOUR_BOT_TOKEN header, or OAuth2 bearer tokens for user/app flows; create apps in Developer Portal

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for standard bot/app API usage; no published per-request fee. Monetization via Discord Premium Apps / SKUs separate from API access.
pricing.paid_plans: Premium Apps / monetization SKUs for paid app features; API access itself is free

rate_limits: Global ~50 req/s per bot; per-route buckets with X-RateLimit-* headers; invalid request limits apply (see docs)
use_cases: send a message to a Discord channel
list guild members for a server
create a slash command for a bot
receive gateway events for new messages
